name: THE MINE: THE CLIMB
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE PROPS
LOOK_AT: Pit props holding up the roof. Somebody's carved initials in one, and a date, and lower down, SORRY.
I counted the props. I wish I hadn't. I'd have liked a round number.
I tapped one, to see. It's fine. I'm not tapping another.
LISTEN_TO: Wood settling. It's been settling for years, and it's very nearly comfortable.
Quiet. I'm holding my breath, and I think the props are too.

overrides.PULL: No. Not even a little. Not even to see.
overrides.TALK_TO: I thanked them. They hold up a hill all day for nothing, and nobody ever says.

subjects.name: THE SHAFT OF LIGHT
LOOK_AT: Daylight, coming down a shaft in the roof in one straight bar. The dust in it looks like it's somewhere better.
There's a disc of sky at the top, the size of a dollar. I know exactly what a dollar looks like. I had four.
A pine needle came down it while I watched, and took its time.
LISTEN_TO: Wind over the top, like breath across a bottle. An F, near enough.
Birds, far up. Up there it's an ordinary day.
The F again, a hair flat. I can't fix it from down here.

overrides.USE: I stood in it for a minute. It's warm. I'd forgotten the sun was still going on, up there.

subjects.name: THE PASSAGE UP
LOOK_AT: A passage climbing steeply, with steps cut in it by somebody who hated steps.
It goes up at an angle a mule would refuse. Grievance was right to stay.
Every step's a different height. Whoever cut them was in a temper, or a hurry, or both.
LISTEN_TO: A drip, somewhere up there. Much like down here.

subjects.name: THE PASSAGE ON
LOOK_AT: A level passage going on into the hill. Easy walking, which makes me suspicious.
Rails along the floor, rusted to the color of the dark.
Somebody laid rails along it, and never came back for them.
LISTEN_TO: A drip along there too. Every passage has one.

subjects.name: THE WAY BACK
LOOK_AT: Back the way I came, toward the three openings.
I could go back. I'd only have to come forward again.
Back there the floor was flat and I knew where I was. I've given that up for now.
LISTEN_TO: The drip on the stake, faint, behind me.
A drip, back by the openings.
